claims.statement: Ptah is an Egyptian creator god and patron of craftsmen and architects.
claims.statement_id: Ptah adalah dewa pencipta Mesir dan pelindung perajin serta arsitek.
claims.quote: is an ancient Egyptian deity, a creator god, and a patron deity of craftsmen and architects.

claims.statement: In the Memphis triad he is Sekhmet’s husband.
claims.statement_id: Dalam triad Memphis, ia menjadi suami Sekhmet.
claims.quote: In the triad of Memphis, he is the husband of Sekhmet and the father of Nefertem.

claims.statement: Nefertem is regarded as his son.
claims.statement_id: Nefertem dianggap sebagai putranya.
claims.quote: In the triad of Memphis, he is the husband of Sekhmet and the father of Nefertem.

claims.statement: Ptah creates the world through conception and speech.
claims.statement_id: Ptah menciptakan dunia melalui gagasan dan ucapan.
claims.quote: Ptah is an Egyptian creator God who conceived the world and brought it into being through the creative power of speech.

claims.statement: The Shabaka Stone connects his giving life with his heart and tongue.
claims.statement_id: Batu Shabaka menghubungkan pemberian kehidupan dengan hati dan lidahnya.
claims.quote: the Shabaka Stone, from the Twenty-Fifth Dynasty, says Ptah "gave life to all the gods and their kas as well, through this heart and this tongue."

claims.statement: He is sometimes represented as a dwarf.
claims.statement_id: Bentuknya kadang digambarkan sebagai sosok kerdil.
claims.quote: Sometimes represented as a dwarf, naked and deformed, his popularity would continue to grow during the Late Period.

claims.statement: His worship spread to the eastern Mediterranean.
claims.statement_id: Pemujaannya menyebar ke kawasan Mediterania timur.
claims.quote: his worship then moved beyond the borders of Egypt and was exported throughout the Eastern Mediterranean.

claims.statement: A common depiction shows a green-skinned man in a shroud.
claims.statement_id: Penggambaran umum memperlihatkan laki-laki berkulit hijau dalam kain pembungkus.
claims.quote: Ptah is generally represented in the guise of a man with green skin, contained in a shroud sticking to the skin, wearing the divine beard, and holding a sceptre combining three powerful symbols of ancient Egyptian religion:

claims.statement: His staff symbols combine power, life and stability.
claims.statement_id: Simbol tongkatnya menggabungkan kuasa, kehidupan, dan kestabilan.
claims.quote: These three combined symbols indicate the three creative powers of the god: power (was), life (ankh) and stability (djed).

claims.statement: Syncretism produces Ptah-Sokar-Osiris.
claims.statement_id: Sinkretisme menghasilkan Ptah-Sokar-Osiris.
claims.quote: Gradually he formed with Osiris a new deity called Ptah-Sokar-Osiris.

claims.statement: World History Encyclopedia connects Ptah with the moringa tree.
claims.statement_id: World History Encyclopedia menghubungkan Ptah dengan pohon moringa.
claims.quote: He was probably an early fertility god and is associated with the moringa tree which, in an early myth, he liked to rest beneath.

claims.statement: In his creative role he is also called Ptah-Nun or Ptah-Naunet.
claims.statement_id: Dalam peran pencipta, ia juga disebut Ptah-Nun atau Ptah-Naunet.
claims.quote: He was sometimes known as Ptah-Nun or Ptah-Naunet in his creative aspect, linking him with the primordial substances of the Ogdoad.

claims.statement: His image wears a skullcap and holds a was-sceptre.
claims.statement_id: Gambarnya memakai penutup kepala rapat dan memegang tongkat was.
claims.quote: He is depicted as a mummified man wearing a skull cap holding the Was scepter of authority with the ankh and djed symbols at the top.

claims.statement: That source states that Ptah appears in the First Dynasty.
claims.statement_id: Sumber itu menyebut Ptah telah muncul pada Dinasti Pertama.
claims.quote: appears in the First Dynastic Period (c. 3150-2613 BCE)

claims.statement: Budge associates Ptah with opening the gods’ mouths in the Book of the Dead.
claims.statement_id: Budge mengaitkan Ptah dengan pembukaan mulut para dewa dalam Kitab Orang Mati.
claims.quote: From certain allusions in the Book of the Dead he is known to have "opened the mouth"

claims.statement: Ptah was also regarded as the father of the sage Imhotep.
claims.statement_id: Ptah juga dianggap sebagai ayah dari bijak Imhotep.
claims.quote: He was also regarded as the father of the sage Imhotep.

claims.statement: A hymn to Ptah from the Twenty-second Dynasty of Egypt says that Ptah crafted the world in the design of his heart.
claims.statement_id: Sebuah himne untuk Ptah dari masa Dinasti Kedua Puluh Dua Mesir menyebut bahwa Ptah membentuk dunia sesuai rancangan hatinya.
claims.quote: A hymn to Ptah dating to the Twenty-second Dynasty of Egypt says Ptah "crafted the world in the design of his heart,"

claims.statement: Through dissemination by the Phoenicians, figures of Ptah are found in Carthage.
claims.statement_id: Melalui penyebaran oleh bangsa Fenisia, figur Ptah ditemukan di Kartago.
claims.quote: Through dissemination by the Phoenicians, we find figures of Ptah in Carthage.

claims.statement: From the Old Kingdom, Ptah quickly absorbs the appearance of Sokar and Tatenen, ancient deities of the Memphite region.
claims.statement_id: Sejak Kerajaan Lama, Ptah dengan cepat menyerap rupa Sokar dan Tatenen, dua dewa kuno kawasan Memphis.
claims.quote: From the Old Kingdom, he quickly absorbs the appearance of Sokar and Tatenen, ancient deities of the Memphite region.

claims.statement: In his Sokar form Ptah is found in a white shroud wearing the Atef crown, an attribute of Osiris; in this capacity he is the patron deity of the necropolis of Saqqara and other famous sites where the royal pyramids were built.
claims.statement_id: Dalam wujud Sokar, Ptah ditemukan terbungkus kain putih dan bermahkota Atef, atribut Osiris; dalam peran itu ia menjadi dewa pelindung nekropolis Saqqara dan situs-situs terkenal lain tempat piramida kerajaan dibangun.
claims.quote: His form of Sokar is found contained in its white shroud wearing the Atef crown, an attribute of Osiris. In this capacity, he represents the patron deity of the necropolis of Saqqara and other famous sites where the royal pyramids were built.

claims.statement: In his Tatenen form Ptah is shown as a young, vigorous man in a crown with two tall plumes around the solar disk. He embodies the underground fire that rumbles and raises the earth; metalworkers and blacksmiths particularly revered him, but he was equally feared because he caused earthquakes and tremors of the Earth's crust.
claims.statement_id: Dalam wujud Tatenen, Ptah digambarkan sebagai lelaki muda yang kuat dengan mahkota berhias dua bulu tinggi yang mengelilingi cakram matahari. Ia melambangkan api bawah tanah yang bergemuruh dan menaikkan bumi; para pandai logam sangat menghormatinya, tetapi ia juga ditakuti karena dialah yang menyebabkan gempa bumi dan getaran kerak bumi.
claims.quote: His Tatenen form is represented by a young and vigorous man wearing a crown with two tall plumes that surround the solar disk. He thus embodies the underground fire that rumbles and raises the earth. As such, he was particularly revered by metalworkers and blacksmiths, but he was equally feared because it was he who caused earthquakes and tremors of the Earth's crust.

claims.statement: Ptah is also embodied in the sacred bull Apis.
claims.statement_id: Ptah juga menjelma dalam diri banteng suci Apis.
claims.quote: Finally, Ptah is embodied in the sacred bull, Apis.

claims.statement: With the major royal projects of the Old Kingdom, the high priests of Ptah were particularly sought after and worked with the vizier as chief architects and master craftsmen, responsible for the decoration of the royal funerary complexes.
claims.statement_id: Pada proyek-proyek kerajaan besar masa Kerajaan Lama, para imam agung Ptah sangat dicari dan bekerja bersama wazir sebagai arsitek kepala dan perajin ulung yang bertanggung jawab atas dekorasi kompleks pemakaman kerajaan.
claims.quote: With the major royal projects of the Old Kingdom, the high priests of Ptah were particularly sought after and worked in concert with the vizier, filling the role of chief architects and master craftsmen, responsible for the decoration of the royal funerary complexes.

claims.statement: At Memphis, the god's role as intercessor with humans was particularly visible in the enclosure that protected his sanctuary; large ears carved on the walls symbolized his role as the god who listens to prayers.
claims.statement_id: Di Memphis, peran dewa sebagai perantara bagi manusia tampak jelas pada tembok pagar yang melindungi tempat sucinya; telinga-telinga besar dipahat pada dinding sebagai lambang perannya sebagai dewa yang mendengarkan doa.
claims.quote: At Memphis, the role of intercessor with humans was particularly visible in the appearance of the enclosure that protected the sanctuary of the god. Large ears were carved on the walls, symbolizing his role as god who listens to prayers.

claims.statement: Memphis was believed to be under the protection of Ptah, the patron of craftsmen; its great temple, Hut-ka-Ptah (meaning "Enclosure of the ka of Ptah"), was one of the most prominent structures in the city.
claims.statement_id: Memphis dipercaya berada di bawah perlindungan Ptah, pelindung para perajin; kuil besarnya, Hut-ka-Ptah (berarti "Pelataran ka Ptah"), termasuk bangunan paling menonjol di kota itu.
claims.quote: Memphis was believed to be under the protection of the god Ptah, the patron of craftsmen. Its great temple, Hut-ka-Ptah (meaning "Enclosure of the ka of Ptah"), was one of the most prominent structures in the city.

claims.statement: World History Encyclopedia calls Ptah the great god of Memphis, creator of the world, lord of truth, and chief god of the city of Memphis and its surrounding area around 3000 BCE.
claims.statement_id: World History Encyclopedia menyebut Ptah sebagai dewa agung Memphis, pencipta dunia, penguasa kebenaran, dan dewa utama kota Memphis serta wilayah sekitarnya sekitar 3000 SM.
claims.quote: Ptah was the great god of Memphis, creator of the world, lord of truth, and chief god of the city of Memphis and its surrounding area c. 3000 BCE.

claims.statement: According to World History Encyclopedia, Ptah was originally the figure who stood on the primordial mound of the ben-ben at the creation of the world.
claims.statement_id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, pada mulanya Ptah adalah sosok yang berdiri di atas gundukan purba benben ketika dunia diciptakan.
claims.quote: Ptah was originally the figure who stood on the primordial mound of the ben-ben at the creation of the world.

claims.statement: According to World History Encyclopedia, Ptah was the patron god of sculptors, craftsmen and builders of monuments because he was thought to have sculpted the earth.
claims.statement_id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Ptah adalah dewa pelindung para pemahat, perajin, dan pembangun monumen karena ia dianggap telah memahat bumi.
claims.quote: He was the patron god of sculptors and craftsmen as well as builders of monuments as he was thought to have sculpted the earth.

claims.statement: Budge writes that Ptah was one of the most active of the three great gods who carried out the commands of Thoth, that he was self-created, and that he was a form of the Sun-god Ra as the "Opener" of the day.
claims.statement_id: Budge menulis bahwa Ptah adalah salah satu dari tiga dewa agung yang paling aktif menjalankan perintah Thoth, bahwa ia tercipta dengan sendirinya, dan bahwa ia adalah wujud dewa matahari Ra sebagai "Pembuka" hari.
claims.quote: PTAH was one of the most active of the three great gods who carried out the commands of Thoth, who gave expression in words to the will of the primeval, creative Power; he was self-created, and was a form of the Sun-god Rā as the "Opener" of the day.

claims.statement: According to Budge, Ptah's feminine counterpart was the goddess Sekhet, and the third member of the triad of which he was the chief was Nefer-Temu.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Budge, pasangan perempuan Ptah adalah dewi Sekhet, dan anggota ketiga dari triad yang dipimpinnya adalah Nefer-Temu.
claims.quote: His feminine counterpart was the goddess SEKHET, and the third member of the triad of which he was the chief was NEFER-TEMU.

claims.statement: The Book of the Dead contains a chapter "of making the transformation into Ptah, of eating cakes, and of drinking ale, and of unfettering the steps, and of becoming a living being in Annu (Heliopolis)".
claims.statement_id: Kitab Orang Mati memuat satu pasal "untuk melakukan perubahan wujud menjadi Ptah, memakan kue, meminum bir, melepaskan langkah yang terbelenggu, dan menjadi makhluk hidup di Annu (Heliopolis)".
claims.quote: The Chapter of making the transformation into Ptah, of eating cakes, and of drinking ale, and of unfettering the steps, and of becoming a living being in Annu (Heliopolis).

claims.statement: In the Book of the Dead chapter of opening the mouth, the speaker asks that the good Ptah open his mouth and that the god of his city loose the swathings which are over his mouth.
claims.statement_id: Dalam pasal Kitab Orang Mati tentang pembukaan mulut, sang penutur memohon agar Ptah yang baik membuka mulutnya dan agar dewa kotanya melepaskan lilitan kain yang ada di atas mulutnya.
claims.quote: May the good Ptah open my mouth, and may the god of my city loose the swathings, even the swathings which are over my mouth.

claims.statement: Maat is an Egyptian goddess personifying truth, order and justice.
claims.statement_id: Maat adalah dewi Mesir yang mempersonifikasikan kebenaran, keteraturan, dan keadilan.
claims.quote: is the ancient Egyptian concept of truth, balance, law, morality, and justice. ... Maat was also the goddess who personified this concept

claims.statement: She regulates stars, seasons and the actions of mortals and gods.
claims.statement_id: Ia mengatur bintang, musim, dan tindakan manusia serta dewa.
claims.quote: regulated the stars, seasons, and the actions of mortals and the deities who had brought order from chaos at the moment of creation.

claims.statement: Isfet is her conceptual opposite, representing chaos and injustice.
claims.statement_id: Isfet menjadi lawan konseptualnya, melambangkan kekacauan dan ketidakadilan.
claims.quote: Her ideological opposite was Isfet (Egyptian jzft), meaning injustice, chaos, violence or to do evil.

claims.statement: Early records of Maat include the Pyramid Texts of Unas.
claims.statement_id: Catatan awal Maat mencakup Teks Piramida Unas.
claims.quote: The earliest surviving records indicating that Maat is the norm for nature and society, in this world and the next, were recorded during the Old Kingdom of Egypt, the earliest substantial surviving examples being found in the Pyramid Texts of Unas (c. 2375 BCE and 2345 BCE).

claims.statement: Thoth is her masculine counterpart in some accounts.
claims.statement_id: Thoth menjadi pasangan maskulinnya dalam sejumlah kisah.
claims.quote: Later, when most goddesses were paired with a male aspect, her masculine counterpart was Thoth, as their attributes are similar. In other accounts, Thoth was paired off with Seshat, goddess of writing and measure, who is a lesser-known deity.

claims.statement: Maat plays a role in weighing the heart in the Duat.
claims.statement_id: Maat berperan dalam penimbangan hati di Duat.
claims.quote: her primary role in ancient Egyptian religion dealt with the Weighing of the Heart that took place in the Duat.

claims.statement: Her feather measures whether a soul may reach the blessed afterlife.
claims.statement_id: Bulunya menentukan kelayakan jiwa mencapai akhirat yang bahagia.
claims.quote: Her feather was the measure that determined whether the souls (considered to reside in the heart) of the departed would reach the paradise of the afterlife successfully.

claims.statement: Pharaohs are depicted with her emblems to express their upholding justice.
claims.statement_id: Firaun digambarkan memakai lambangnya untuk menunjukkan penegakan keadilan.
claims.quote: Pharaohs are often depicted with the emblems of Maat to emphasise their roles in upholding the laws and righteousness. From the Eighteenth Dynasty (c. 1550 – 1295 BC) Maat was described as the daughter of Ra, indicating that pharaohs were believed to rule through her authority.

claims.statement: She is depicted as a young woman, sometimes winged or wearing an ostrich feather.
claims.statement_id: Ia digambarkan sebagai perempuan muda, kadang bersayap atau memakai bulu burung unta.
claims.quote: Maat was the goddess of harmony, justice, and truth represented as a young woman. Sometimes she is depicted with wings on each arm or as a woman with an ostrich feather on her head. The meaning of this emblem is uncertain, although the god Shu, who in some myths is Maat's brother, also wears it.

claims.statement: Kings have a duty to maintain Maat in the world’s order.
claims.statement_id: Raja mempunyai tugas menjaga Maat tetap hadir dalam tatanan dunia.
claims.quote: Kings inherited the duty to ensure Maat remained in place, and they with Ra are said to "live on Maat"

claims.statement: Maat remains with the soul in the paradise of the Field of Reeds.
claims.statement_id: Maat tetap hadir bersama jiwa di surga Padang Alang-Alang.
claims.quote: continued as a presence in the paradise of the Field of Reeds.

claims.statement: This source translates ma’at as that which is straight.
claims.statement_id: Sumber ini menerjemahkan kata ma’at sebagai yang lurus.
claims.quote: The word means "that which is straight" and the concept of harmony infused every aspect of an Egyptian's life.

claims.statement: The principle of Maat connects actions with their appropriate time.
claims.statement_id: Prinsip Maat mengaitkan tindakan dengan waktu yang tepat.
claims.quote: There is a time for every action and aspect of existence within ma'at but all must be recognized and acted upon at appropriate times.

claims.statement: According to this source, Maat’s harmony permeates Egyptian culture.
claims.statement_id: Menurut sumber ini, keharmonisan Maat menjiwai budaya Mesir.
claims.quote: Ma'at embodied the principle of ma'at (harmony) which was central to the culture of ancient Egypt.

claims.statement: In Budge’s interpretation of one legend, Maat assists Khepera as creative wisdom.
claims.statement_id: Dalam penafsiran Budge atas satu legenda, Maat membantu Khepera sebagai kebijaksanaan penciptaan.
claims.quote: In arranging his thoughts and their visible forms Khepera was assisted by the goddess Maat

claims.statement: Nephthys is an Egyptian goddess belonging to the Heliopolitan Ennead.
claims.statement_id: Nephthys adalah dewi Mesir anggota Ennead Heliopolis.
claims.quote: was a goddess in ancient Egyptian religion. A member of the Great Ennead of Heliopolis in Egyptian mythology

claims.statement: She is a daughter of Nut and Geb.
claims.statement_id: Ia putri Nut dan Geb.
claims.quote: she was a daughter of Nut and Geb.

claims.statement: Isis is her sister and partner in funerary rites.
claims.statement_id: Isis adalah saudarinya dan pasangan dalam ritual pemakaman.
claims.quote: Nephthys was typically paired with her sister Isis in funerary rites because of their role as protectresses of the mummy

claims.statement: She is described as Set’s sister and wife.
claims.statement_id: Ia disebut saudari sekaligus istri Set.
claims.quote: as the sister-wife of Set. She

claims.statement: She is associated with mourning, night and protection.
claims.statement_id: Ia dikaitkan dengan perkabungan, malam, dan perlindungan.
claims.quote: She was associated with mourning, the night/darkness, service (specifically temples), childbirth, the dead, protection, magic, health, embalming, and beer.

claims.statement: Her name is usually translated as Lady of the House or Lady of the Temple.
claims.statement_id: Namanya lazim diterjemahkan sebagai Nyonya Rumah atau Nyonya Kuil.
claims.quote: Nephthys is the Greek form of an epithet (transliterated as Nebet-hut, Nebet-het, Nebt-het, from Egyptian nbt-ḥwt). The origin of the goddess Nephthys is unclear but the literal translation of her name is usually given as Lady of the House or Lady of the Temple.

claims.statement: With Isis she symbolizes a temple’s pylon gateway.
claims.statement_id: Bersama Isis ia melambangkan gerbang pylon kuil.
claims.quote: Along with her sister Isis, Nephthys represented the temple pylon or trapezoidal tower gateway entrance to the temple

claims.statement: She is viewed as a protective goddess symbolizing the death experience.
claims.statement_id: Ia dipandang sebagai dewi pelindung yang melambangkan pengalaman kematian.
claims.quote: Nephthys is a protective goddess who symbolizes the death experience

claims.statement: Some myths make her Anubis’s mother; others give him a different mother.
claims.statement_id: Sebagian mitos menjadikannya ibu Anubis; kisah lain memberi Anubis ibu berbeda.
claims.quote: Nephthys is regarded as the mother of the funerary deity Anubis (Inpu) in some myths. Alternatively Anubis appears as the son of Bastet or Isis. In Nubia, Nephthys was said to be the wife of Anubis.

claims.statement: She also acts as a nurse to the pharaoh.
claims.statement_id: Ia juga berperan sebagai pengasuh firaun.
claims.quote: Nephthys also was considered to be the nurse of the reigning pharaoh himself.

claims.statement: She is known as Friend of the Dead.
claims.statement_id: Ia dikenal sebagai Sahabat Orang Mati.
claims.quote: She was known as "Friend of the Dead" for her care of the souls in the afterlife

claims.statement: Professional mourners are called the Kites of Nephthys.
claims.statement_id: Peratap profesional disebut Layang-Layang Nephthys.
claims.quote: professional mourners at funerals, who encouraged the open expression of grief, were known as the "Kites of Nephthys".

claims.statement: The Lamentations of Isis and Nephthys is used at festivals, services and funerals.
claims.statement_id: Lamentations of Isis and Nephthys dipakai dalam festival, ibadah, dan pemakaman.
claims.quote: This text was recited regularly at festivals, services, and funerals throughout Egypt.

claims.statement: In that text she calls Osiris’s soul back from death.
claims.statement_id: Dalam teks tersebut ia memanggil jiwa Osiris kembali dari kematian.
claims.quote: In the text The Lamentations of Isis and Nephthys she calls the soul of Osiris back from the dead.

claims.statement: Budge describes Nephthys’s place in the solar boat at creation and her connection with twilight.
claims.statement_id: Budge menyebut tempat Nephthys dalam bahtera matahari saat penciptaan dan kaitannya dengan senja.
claims.quote: like her she had a place in the boat of the Sun at creation, when she probably typified the twilight or very early night.

claims.statement: Nut is the goddess of sky and stars in ancient Egyptian religion.
claims.statement_id: Nut adalah dewi langit dan bintang dalam agama Mesir kuno.
claims.quote: is the goddess of the sky, stars, cosmos, mothers, astronomy, and the universe in the ancient Egyptian religion.

claims.statement: She is often depicted as a star-covered woman arching over the earth.
claims.statement_id: Ia sering digambarkan sebagai perempuan berbintang yang melengkung di atas bumi.
claims.quote: She is often depicted as a nude woman covered with stars and arching over the Earth; and sometimes as a cow. Alternatively, she is identified with a water-pot (nw) above her head.

claims.statement: She can also be depicted as a cow.
claims.statement_id: Ia juga dapat digambarkan sebagai sapi.
claims.quote: and sometimes as a cow. Alternatively,

claims.statement: Her name also means sky and has several transcriptions.
claims.statement_id: Namanya juga berarti langit dan memiliki sejumlah transkripsi.
claims.quote: Her name Nwt, itself also meaning "Sky", is usually transcribed as "Nut" but also sometimes appears in older sources as Nunut, Nenet, Nuit or Not.

claims.statement: Shu and Tefnut are her parents.
claims.statement_id: Shu dan Tefnut adalah orang tuanya.
claims.quote: Nut is a daughter of Shu and Tefnut.

claims.statement: Geb is her brother and husband.
claims.statement_id: Geb adalah saudara laki-laki sekaligus suaminya.
claims.quote: Her brother and husband is Geb.

claims.statement: Her children include Osiris, Set, Isis and Nephthys.
claims.statement_id: Anak-anaknya mencakup Osiris, Set, Isis, dan Nephthys.
claims.quote: She had four children – Osiris, Set, Isis, and Nephthys

claims.statement: Her origins are linked to the Heliopolitan creation story.
claims.statement_id: Asalnya berkaitan dengan kisah penciptaan Heliopolis.
claims.quote: her origin being found on the creation story of Heliopolis.

claims.statement: The maqet ladder is a symbol of Nut placed in tombs for protection.
claims.statement_id: Tangga maqet menjadi lambang Nut dan dipasang di makam untuk perlindungan.
claims.quote: A sacred symbol of Nut was the ladder used by Osiris to enter her heavenly skies. This ladder-symbol was called maqet and was placed in tombs to protect the deceased, and to invoke the aid of the deity of the dead. Nut and her brother, Geb, may be considered enigmas in the world of mythology.

claims.statement: Nut personifies the sky while Geb personifies the earth.
claims.statement_id: Nut mewakili langit, sedangkan Geb mewakili bumi.
claims.quote: she personified the sky and he the Earth.

claims.statement: One tale forbids Nut to give birth on any day of the original year.
claims.statement_id: Salah satu kisah melarang Nut melahirkan pada hari mana pun dalam tahun semula.
claims.quote: He also decreed that she could not give birth on any day of the year.

claims.statement: Thoth wins five days’ worth of moonlight from Iah.
claims.statement_id: Thoth memenangkan cahaya bulan senilai lima hari dari Iah.
claims.quote: Thoth, the god of wisdom, gambled with Iah, god of the moon, and won five days worth of moonlight which he transformed into days.

claims.statement: The additional days allow Nut to bear her five children.
claims.statement_id: Hari tambahan memungkinkan Nut melahirkan kelima anaknya.
claims.quote: Nut was able to then give birth to her five children on five consecutive days in July

claims.statement: Another version makes Khonsu the loser in that game.
claims.statement_id: Versi lain menjadikan Khonsu sebagai pihak yang kalah dalam permainan itu.
claims.quote: In some versions of the story it is Khonsu who loses the gamble with Thoth.

claims.statement: Budge records Nut and Geb as givers of food to both the living and dead.
claims.statement_id: Budge mencatat Nut dan Geb sebagai pemberi makanan bagi orang hidup maupun mati.
claims.quote: she and her husband Seb were considered to be the givers of food, not only to the living but also to the dead.
